Shell.description: IELTS Writing practice with criterion-by-criterion feedback tied to your own text.
Shell.disclaimer: Unofficial practice tool. IELTS is a registered trademark of its owners; this site is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Score ranges are approximate, not official results.

descriptions.join: Already use GoNative or GoNative Worksheets? Sign in with the same email and password to start using Exams.
descriptions.register: One GoNative account works for Exams, the GoNative app and Worksheets.
descriptions.forgot: Enter your account email. If the account exists, we will send a link to set a new password.
descriptions.reset: The new password applies to your whole GoNative account.
descriptions.activate: Confirm the email address of your new account to start using Exams.
descriptions.resend: Enter the email and password you registered with, and we will send a new confirmation link.

Writing.title: Writing
Writing.lead: Write an essay on a practice task or your own, and get feedback on each criterion tied to your text.
Writing.quota: {remaining} of {limit} free feedbacks left this month
Writing.quotaEmpty: You can keep writing drafts; feedback renews on {date}.
Writing.noEssays: No essays yet. Start with a practice task.

Welcome.title: Set up GoNative Exams
Welcome.lead: Two choices and two confirmations. You can change the choices later in Settings.
Welcome.feedbackHint: Explanations of your mistakes come in this language. Corrections are always in English.
Welcome.examHint: Academic or General Training. Writing Task 2 is the same in both.
Welcome.terms: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
Welcome.aiNotice: Submitted essays are assessed automatically with AI (Anthropic). Drafts are not sent to AI. Score ranges are approximate, not official results.
Welcome.termsUpdating: The Terms are being updated. Please try again in a few minutes.
Welcome.terms_changed: The Terms have just changed. Reload the page to read the new version.

data.title: Delete Exams data
data.body: Permanently deletes your essays, feedback, statistics, reports and entered results. Your GoNative account, the GoNative app and Worksheets are not affected.
data.confirm: I understand that my Exams data will be deleted permanently.

account.title: Close GoNative account
account.body: Closes your shared GoNative account and deletes your data in every GoNative product: Exams, the GoNative app and Worksheets.
account.confirm: I understand that this closes my account in all GoNative products.
